about: Letters to future me (specs/1.2-features.md §3, UX 2026-11-09; the Reviewer's read; server specs/letters-server-draft.md, migration 027). Its home since the app port (decision 99): the web syncs it from here with scripts/sync-contracts.mjs. A letter is its own row, never an entry, so nothing that reads entries sees one; no AI reads it; opened letters stay out of search and Insights in this version. Written from Me, opening one of monthChoices after the day it's written, in the person's saved zone (the server sets opens_on; clients read it, never compute it). Up to maxChars characters, never blank. Locked: no opened_at. While locked a client shows only its dates, never its text, and the text isn't sent to the client at all until it's opened. On its day (opens_on, or card_from after Not now) Today shows one card, oldest first: the date it was written, Open and Not now; Not now moves it notNowDays on, again each time. Open early is allowed, with a confirm. Delete with a confirm; no edit once saved. No crisis flag is stored: the current matcher runs on the text at saving (the help card opens) and on the opening day, where the text is read on the server (the help offer goes above the card; the card gets a yes or no, not the text). A hard last week puts the help offer above it too. The app (UX 2026-11-10) keeps a locked letter's text off the phone until Open: it matches at saving and at every opening, the help offer above the opened letter; it has no hard-week rule yet, which comes with its rules-based Your week. Locked is a display rule, never encryption: no copy says sealed or secure, and the export has the text, marked. 1.3 reminders (migration 033; Vitor 14 Nov; boards 26/26b v54; UX 14 Nov): set when the letter is written, never edited; letters.reminders holds at most maxHeadsUps heads-ups plus On the day (days_before 0), each {days_before, time "HH:MM" on the person's clock, on}; NULL or left out = the default. A heads-up is days_before whole days before opens_on and must fall after the writing day (days_before < opens_on - today); clients offer quickDays and show any other value as "{n} days before"; the editor lists heads-ups furthest first, On the day last. Only the app schedules them, at each one that's on, counted back from opens_on: Not now and Today's card change nothing; opening (early or on the day) and delete cancel them; they don't depend on the daily check-in reminder or on Plus. Notification words stay generic.
